description: Installed at the 1 Wing Historical Centre on 11 June 2023 per the International F-104 Society

Listed by the International F-104 Society at the Bevekom 1st Wing Historical Museum which it says can be visited on the first and third Sunday of each month between 13.30 and 18.00; the museum's own published hours are the second and fourth Sunday so the visiting days need confirming
Wearing an early 1960s colour scheme per the International F-104 Society
Listed among the collection by vintageaviationnews.com; no serial published and the former operator is not stated
